verdicts.reason: Both have the same problems: the content block is pushed low, leaving an empty band at the top and empty space on the left. The headline wraps and leaves 'shop' alone on its own line, and the 'See All Events' button is tiny, cramped under the subcopy and close to the bottom edge. A keeps the logo at a sensible size; B shrinks the logo until it is a minor element and the 'BOOKS' line is barely readable.

The two images are the same. The logo is shrunk to a small mark jammed against the left edge, and 'shop' sits alone on the second headline line. The CTA is shrunk to a small pill under 'night.', the block hangs low over an empty top band, and the right third of the canvas is dead space.

The two images are the same. The headline is oversized and leaves 'shop' alone on its own line. The subcopy and the tiny CTA are stacked tight against it and the bottom edge, while the top band is empty. The logo moves to the right, which reverses the original reading order, and the CTA is too small to stand out.

A has the low-hanging block, 'shop' alone on its own line, a tiny cramped CTA, and the logo moved to the right. B keeps the original three-column banner order: logo, then headline and subcopy, then the full-size CTA. It is vertically centred with clean spacing and the logo stays in proportion. Its only weakness is generous empty bands above and below, and the subcopy sits a bit far from the headline.
